user_version 22

table account_owner
CREATE TABLE account_owner (
    account_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    email      TEXT    NOT NULL
)

table addresses
CREATE TABLE addresses (
    email TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

table attachment_meta
CREATE TABLE attachment_meta (
    account_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    folder_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    uid         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    idx         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name        TEXT    NOT NULL,
    mime        TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    size        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    section     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    ext         TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    bucket      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 6,
    keywords    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    PRIMARY KEY (account_id, folder_path, uid, idx)
)

index attachment_meta_by_folder
CREATE INDEX attachment_meta_by_folder
    ON attachment_meta (account_id, folder_path)

table attachment_scan
CREATE TABLE attachment_scan (
    account_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    folder_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    uid         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (account_id, folder_path, uid)
)

table attachments
CREATE TABLE attachments (
    account_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    folder_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    uid         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    idx         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    data        BLOB NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (account_id, folder_path, uid, idx)
)

table attachments_checked
CREATE TABLE attachments_checked (
    account_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    folder_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    uid         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (account_id, folder_path, uid)
)

table bodies
CREATE TABLE bodies (
    account_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    folder_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    uid         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    body        TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (account_id, folder_path, uid)
)

table body_text
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE body_text USING fts5(
    text, content='', contentless_delete=1, tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2'
)

table body_text_config
CREATE TABLE 'body_text_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID

table body_text_data
CREATE TABLE 'body_text_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)

table body_text_docsize
CREATE TABLE 'body_text_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB, origin INTEGER)

trigger body_text_gone
CREATE TRIGGER body_text_gone AFTER DELETE ON bodies BEGIN
    DELETE FROM body_text WHERE rowid = old.rowid;
END

table body_text_idx
CREATE TABLE 'body_text_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

table folders
CREATE TABLE folders (
    account_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    path       TEXT    NOT NULL,
    name       TEXT    NOT NULL,
    kind       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unread     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ord        INTEGER NOT NULL,
    childless  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (account_id, path)
)

table imap_hierarchy
CREATE TABLE imap_hierarchy (
    account_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    delimiter  TEXT,
    prefix     TEXT,
    said       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
)

table label_fill
CREATE TABLE label_fill (
    account_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    folder_path TEXT    NOT NULL,
    next_uid    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    done        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (account_id, folder_path)
)

table local_copies
CREATE TABLE local_copies (
    account_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    message_id  TEXT    NOT NULL,
    folder_path TEXT    NOT NULL,
    uid         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (account_id, message_id, folder_path, uid)
)

table local_tags
CREATE TABLE local_tags (
    account_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    message_id  TEXT    NOT NULL,
    keyword     TEXT    NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (account_id, message_id, keyword)
)

table messages
CREATE TABLE messages (
    account_id     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    folder_path    TEXT    NOT NULL,
    uid            INTEGER NOT NULL,
    from_name      TEXT    NOT NULL,
    from_addr      TEXT    NOT NULL,
    recipients     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    cc             TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject        TEXT    NOT NULL,
    date           TEXT    NOT NULL,
    ts             INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unread         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    starred        INTEGER NOT NULL,
    has_attachment INTEGER NOT NULL,
    message_id     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    references_    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    preview        TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    reply_to       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    keywords       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    importance     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    due            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    gmail_labels   TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    answered       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    forwarded      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    bcc            TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    PRIMARY KEY (account_id, folder_path, uid)
)

index messages_by_folder_ts
CREATE INDEX messages_by_folder_ts ON messages (account_id, folder_path, ts)

index messages_by_message_id
CREATE INDEX messages_by_message_id ON messages (message_id)

index messages_starred
CREATE INDEX messages_starred ON messages (account_id, ts) WHERE starred = 1

table msgid_case
CREATE TABLE msgid_case (
    lower TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    exact TEXT NOT NULL
)

table outbox
CREATE TABLE outbox (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    account_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    from_addr   TEXT    NOT NULL,
    rcpts       TEXT    NOT NULL,
    recipients  TEXT    NOT NULL,
    subject     TEXT    NOT NULL,
    preview     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    raw         BLOB    NOT NULL,
    sent_path   TEXT,
    queued_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    attempts    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    last_error  TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    send_at     INTEGER,
    forwards    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

table refs_repair
CREATE TABLE refs_repair (
    account_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    folder_path TEXT    NOT NULL,
    next_uid    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    done        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (account_id, folder_path)
)

table sender_checks
CREATE TABLE sender_checks (
    account_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    folder_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    uid         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    trust       TEXT NOT NULL,
    summary     TEXT NOT NULL,
    findings    TEXT NOT NULL,
    pgp         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    unsubscribe TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    invite      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    label       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    receipt     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    authority   TEXT,
    from_domain TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    PRIMARY KEY (account_id, folder_path, uid)
)

index sqlite_autoindex_addresses_1


index sqlite_autoindex_attachment_meta_1


index sqlite_autoindex_attachment_scan_1


index sqlite_autoindex_attachments_1


index sqlite_autoindex_attachments_checked_1


index sqlite_autoindex_bodies_1


index sqlite_autoindex_folders_1


index sqlite_autoindex_label_fill_1


index sqlite_autoindex_local_copies_1


index sqlite_autoindex_local_tags_1


index sqlite_autoindex_messages_1


index sqlite_autoindex_msgid_case_1


index sqlite_autoindex_refs_repair_1


index sqlite_autoindex_sender_checks_1


table sqlite_sequence
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)
